card.name: Water delivery and spray reach
card.fires_on: Small words and spots in text about spreading water or signals over an area, such as irrigation, sprinklers and pipes to zones. It fires where the text is about to say how widely something reaches.

modes.label: Water distribution
modes.description: Linking words in text on irrigation, sprinklers or pipes that deliver water across an area.
modes.example: Position your sprinklers<< so>> they don’t spray the sidewalks or driveway

modes.label: Reach to people or places
modes.description: A space or word just before a count of people served or an area covered.
modes.example: The dam is intended to bring drinking water to<< >>40 million people, irrigate farms

modes.label: Area contact
modes.description: The word area in a passage about how much surface is touched.
modes.example: The patient may be repositioned every 15 minutes for maximum<< area>> contact.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word coverage (also in Chinese) and away from pack-type words.
card.plain: It marks places where the text is about how far water or a service spreads, so the next word may be coverage.
